Sections.Title: Multiple commands
Sections.Text:
Sometimes you want to fire off more than one command at once. For that, use
tea.Batch.

Sections.Title: Commands with arguments
Sections.Text:
Okay, so what if you want to make a command that takes an argument? Since Cmd
is a func() tea.Msg, it can’t take an argument. So what do you do in that
case? Well, you make a function that returns a command.

A lot of the time you’ll want to make API calls from Bubble Tea. Commands are
great for this.

Sections.Title: Injecting messages from outside the program
Sections.Text:
Commands work great from within a Bubble Tea program, but what if you want to send
messages to Update from outside the program? Enter
